title: Trading
description: Buying and selling at the market panel. The feature document, trading.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: Trading at the market panel
entities.description: Docked, the pilot buys and sells any goods, in any order, a quantity at a time.
entities.behavior: A buy takes quantity × price from the cash, adds the cargo and lowers the availability; a sale adds the cash and lowers the cargo. Prices use the current system's economy and the pilot's stored market byte. The stepper offers at most max_buy (the smallest of availability, hold room and the whole units the cash pays for) or max_sell (the cargo held).
entities.outcome: The pilot makes a living by buying cheap and selling dear.
constraints: Only while docked: FlyInSystem drops Buy and Sell presses in any other mode.
A buy is refused in the order more than available, no room, not enough cash; a refusal changes nothing.
Selling never restores availability; there is no price spread (deliberate difference 12).

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
